fullContentHtml:
TNPSC Group 2 & 2A Preliminary Hall Ticket 2026 – Download Admit Card

The Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC) has issued the hall tickets for the Combined Civil Services Examination-II (Group 2 & Group 2A Services) preliminary test scheduled for 01 November 2026. Candidates who submitted their online applications must download their hall ticket well before the examination date to verify their designated exam centre and roll number.

Important Dates

  • Hall Ticket Release Date : 21 October 2026
  • Preliminary Written Exam Date : 01 November 2026
  • Examination Timing : 09:30 AM to 12:30 PM (Candidates must report by 08:30 AM)
  • Answer Key Release : Within 3 to 5 days after exam

How to Download TNPSC Group 2 & 2A Hall Ticket 2026

  1. Navigate to the official Tamil Nadu PSC exams portal at tnpscexams.in or tnpsc.gov.in.
  2. Click on the 'One Time Registration & Dashboard' (OTR) link on the homepage.
  3. Enter your registered Login ID and Password.
  4. Locate the section labeled 'Download Hall Ticket / Combined Civil Services Examination-II (Group II & IIA)'.
  5. Input your Application Number and Date of Birth as recorded during submission.
  6. Your hall ticket will appear on screen; download the PDF file and print a clear hard copy.

  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

When was the TNPSC Group 2 Hall Ticket released?

TNPSC released the Group 2 & 2A preliminary examination hall tickets on 21 October 2026.

What is the TNPSC Group 2 Preliminary Exam Date 2026?

The preliminary examination is scheduled for Sunday, 01 November 2026, from 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM across all designated district examination centers in Tamil Nadu.

What credentials are required to download the hall ticket?

Candidates need their OTR Login ID, Application Number, and Date of Birth to access and download the hall ticket.
